prose.against: The case against rests mostly on the recent price trend: momentum scores only 6 of 100 against the comparison pool. Other areas on this side: price behaviour, risk, growth.
prose.weighing: Weighing them: 6 points in favour and 10 against give more points against. The pool score is 53 of 100. The side that carries most weight is the recent price trend.
